verdict.rationale: Anytype's own docs show that linking connects Objects into a knowledge base, that each link is registered and shown in the Knowledge Graph, and that you can 'trace how ideas relate, see what's connected', which only loosely implies backlink visibility. Nothing documents [[wiki-style]] link syntax, a backlinks panel showing each reference in context, or unlinked mention detection. missing for 10: documented [[ ]] wiki-link syntax, explicit backlinks view with surrounding context, unlinked mentions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
